title: Vikram and Betal: The Fair Leader

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a fair leader.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a leader who treated everyone equally.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: Two villagers wanted the same land.
scenes.image_prompt: two villagers arguing over land cartoon

scenes.text: The leader listened to both sides before deciding.
scenes.image_prompt: leader listening to both villagers cartoon

scenes.summary: The leader makes a fair decision.
scenes.text: He asked them to share the land equally.
Both villagers agreed and peace returned. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: villagers smiling and shaking hands cartoon

story: A fair leader solved a land dispute by sharing it equally. Vikram said fairness brings peace.
